name: Goblin Skycutter — fired "That creature loses flying" keeps "with flying" in its target
notes: Found by tests/audit.py (2026-11-17). Fired, "It deals 2 damage to target creature with flying. That creature loses flying until end of turn" was rewritten to "Target creature loses flying": the target phrase reader (_TARGET_PHRASE_RE in cards-helpers.js) stopped before "with flying", so the picker listed every creature. It now keeps a "with / without <keyword>" tail.
